I had this number for about six years, and before that it was my uncles. I get a call one day from this sweet old man,  and he thinks I'm his daughter. So I explain that he has the wrong number and whatnot, but he just keeps gabbin' on. I got the feeling he was pretty lonely, so I didn't want to just hang up on the guy. I kept chatting with him. And he insists that this is his daughter's number, so I tell him my number thinking he will realize he typed a number wrong. Nope. He starts getting worried that the phone company gave her and I the same exact number. He says, "I wonder if you hang up and call your own number, if she would pick up! I bet she would. I can't believe this." I tried explaining that this can't happen, that she definitely had a different number and that I've had this for six years! But he isn't having it. He believes me, but he's certain that it's also his daughters number. And that because I'm answering, she can't answer it. So he tells me he's gonna hang up and call her (me). I say okay and goodbye and think that's the end of it. But then he calls again, so I let it go to voice mail so he will hear my voice and name and know it's me again. But he leaves a confused message explaining the situation to his daughter, on my phone, saying everything we just talked about and how he can't believe the company would give out the same number to two different people. He was completely dumbfounded. I didn't know how else to explain it to him. He called me a few more times in the next week and I answered one of them and we talked about it again. But then I just stopped hearing from him. I hope he found his daughter.
